column1: # MANUALLY MANAGED - reviewed platform-only dispositions for config/units.toml
# units with no Mac counterpart (read by `homm3 mac objects`). A row needs
# positive evidence that the Mac executable has no body from the unit; a
# compile failure or missing string literals is not such evidence.

column3: Immersion iFeel layer over IFC20.dll. The PEF loader imports only MathLib, AppearanceLib, InterfaceLib, SoundLib, QuickTimeLib, OTUtilityLib, OTClientUtilLib, OTClientLib, OTXTILib, OTInetClientLib, DrawSprocketLib, OTATalkSharedLib and Bink Shared Library (no IFC). Retail RTTI names this TU's thrown types (t_initializer::t_initialize_failure, force_feedback::t_enclosure::t_create_failure); `homm3 mac find --string` finds none of t_initialize_failure, t_create_failure, t_enclosure, force_feedback, CImmEnclosure or CImmMouse in the PEF, while other thrown project types' RTTI names (TRuntimeError, TAllocationFailure, TDebugBreak) are present. No source function claims a MAC_ADDRESS.

x86 inline-assembly kernels behind Victor's loadpcx (RLE decoder and planar unpackers). PCX RLE decoding tests the 0xC0 run marker and masks the 0x3F count; a scan of the whole Mac code section finds only seven compare-immediates against 0xBF/0xC0/0xC1 (0x67970 character ranges; 0x137274/0x13a188 switch trees; 0x26eb68; 0x297214) and three 0xC0 bit tests (0x99c, 0x28ea40, 0x28f8f0: MSL ctype), none of them an RLE loop, and no 0x3F mask. No source function claims a MAC_ADDRESS.

Win32 CreateFile/ReadFile file layer. The Mac executable implements file I/O over the File Manager instead: its loader-proven import glue includes FSpOpenDF, FSRead, FSWrite, GetEOF, FSClose, FSpCreate and FSpDelete from InterfaceLib, called from its own implementation at 0:0x277e5c..0x2780c8. No MAC_ADDRESS claims; the Mac target is a VC6 steering aid, so this platform layer is not reproduced.

DirectPlay session layer. The Mac executable networks over OpenTransport: its import libraries are InterfaceLib, OTClientLib, OTClientUtilLib, OTInetClientLib, OTATalkSharedLib, OTUtilityLib and six non-network libraries, with no DirectPlay. Some CDPlay types survive (RTTI CAutoArray<CDPlayPlayer>) but no DirectPlay body has a MAC_ADDRESS claim; the Mac target is a VC6 steering aid, so this platform layer is not reproduced.
